text:
The change adds an audit entry after saving a note, but the shared catch also suppresses storage failures. If `mkdir` or `writeFile` fails, `createNote` logs an audit warning and returns HTTP 201 with an unsaved note. Previously, that failure propagated. Keep `saveNote` outside the audit error handler.

No tests are present in this checkout to cover this failure path.
